note: Set B is better because it avoids the exact duplicate claims found in Set A (e.g., phase 0 deg at 0.01 Hz appears twice in A) and has fewer contradictory point readings for the phase at 1.00 Hz (A has three conflicting values: -75, -72, -80; B has two: -75, -80). Set B also provides useful range summaries for the Bode plot response. Both sets share errors regarding the unsupported -80 deg claim and conflicting magnitude values at 1.00 Hz.
remarks: Both sets hallucinate a -80 deg phase value at 1.00 Hz despite the graph showing -75 deg and quotes often citing -75. Both sets contradict themselves on the magnitude at 1.00 Hz (-12 vs -12.5 dB).
